channel.description: Latest articles from Covering Katy News (coveringkaty.com)

item.title: Taylor defeats Bonin for Ward A Katy City Council seat
item.description: Katy High School Paula Taylor defeated contractor Cara Bonin Saturday in a special election to fill an open seat.

item.title: National Weather Service Forecast: Next 7 Days
Katy ISD assistant principal honored with regional award
item.description: A Katy ISD assistant principal has been named the 2026 Region 4 Assistant Principal of the Year by the Texas Elementary Principals and Supervisors Association.

item.title: Retiring County Clerk Laura Richard Endorses J.J. Clemence to Replace Her
item.description: Fort Bend County Clerk Laura Richard endorses J.J. Clemence in the Republican primary for county clerk, citing temperament, fiscal, responsibility and experience managing large operations.

item.title: Victor Perez quits McFarlane Campaign due to 'negativity' and 'divisiveness'
item.description: The former campaign treasurer for Tamara McFarlane's Fort Bend County Clerk's race has resigned, citing unhappiness with the campaign's negativity and divisiveness.

item.title: Katy man convicted in murder-for-hire plot that targeted wrong victim
item.description: Michael Seery, 43, was found guilty on multiple charges following an eight-day trial, U.S. Attorney Nicholas J. Ganjei announced. Also convicted was Ricardo Obando Jr., 51, of Houston, who authorities say carried out the shooting.

item.title: Prosecutors reveal evidence against Katy area murder suspect
item.description: Toll road records, surveillance video and witness identification led investigators to charge a 41-year-old Round Rock man with capital murder in the shooting deaths of two people at a Katy area home on Jan. 12, 2026.

item.title: Katy Council to consider easing redevelopment rules for iconic rice dryers and other historic structures
item.description: The Katy City Council is expected to discuss the possible creation of a historical preservation board that could help in the redevelopment of an iconic Katy landmark. The council is to meet Monday afternoon at Katy City Hall.

item.title: Many Cinco Ranch MUD residents must update payment information as billing system changes
item.description: Cinco Ranch municipal utility district residents should watch for instructions on their water bills this month about updating payment information as the districts transition to a new billing software system and online customer portal.

item.title: Alamo Drafthouse Cinema in Katy closes, ending Houston-area presence after 22 years
item.description: Alamo Drafthouse Cinema closed its La Centerra location in Katy on Saturday, ending the theater chain's presence in the Greater Houston area after more than two decades.
